description: Adds board text to the board the teacher has open, behind a live link (.../live/<id>). place "current_page": put it under what is on the page the teacher is on (write ONE page: the next step, a hint, a drawing). place "new_pages": add your pages after the last page (exercises, answers, a new topic). Call check_board first: a text with errors is not added. Nothing on the board is changed or removed; the teacher can undo the addition.

link.description: The live link the user gave you: .../live/<id>.

place.description: "current_page" (under what is on the teacher's page; one page of text) or "new_pages" (after the last page).

text.description: The whole board in the Math Board format: # title, :::companion, :::font and :::show lines under it, ## pages, Markdown with $...$ formulas and [words]{red highlight} spans, :::graph, :::geometry, :::solid blocks, and :::comment, :::say blocks and :::mood, :::show lines and marks (:::strike "+3", :::cancel, :::cross, :::underline, :::double, :::circle, :::box, and :::unmark to rub one out) under ### step headings. The ~~~mathboard fence around it is optional.

name: add_to_board
title: Add to the open board
